text: v1.0.6 is out: the Tracker's profit card is rebuilt. Today shows only today's games and reads $0.00 until one is graded. Open bets are money at stake, never a loss. All-time profit is your Vigilant wallet (cash plus open bets) minus what you put in, net of every withdrawal. Install: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.6
